prompt:
Write 6 short claim log entries (one to three sentences each) by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim, in time order. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1308; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- Witnesses and the officer say the claimant was not in the vehicle when the crash happened.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- Nothing suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text:
Entry 1: Claimant reported a left-turn collision at an intersection and described the other vehicle pulling out in front of them. The claimant has no attorney and is handling the claim personally.

Entry 2: Scene photos, two independent witness statements, and the other driver's account all match the claimant's description of how the collision happened. The damage to the claimant's vehicle is consistent with the reported impact.

Entry 3: The claimant reports a concussion and has been treated on a routine course that has tapered as symptoms improved. No earlier injury to the same area of the body is known. It is not yet clear whether this injury came from the collision.

Entry 4: Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the start of coverage, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known. The driver is named on the policy.

Entry 5: The responding officer and two witnesses state that the claimant was not inside the vehicle when the crash occurred, which conflicts with the account given so far. I have requested the officer's full report and the witness contact details to clarify this point.

Entry 6: The claimant has repeated the same account in every conversation to date. The open questions remain the cause of the injury and the discrepancy about the claimant's position in the vehicle, and the file will stay open until both are resolved.
